d: The incumbent will have the day to day responsibility for Clients Corporate Accounting & Reporting function for companies and SPCs, mainly incorporated in Cayman, along with overseeing the activities, outputs and processes including all relevant financial statements.

Fund Accountant will also have a strong foundation in financial accounting as applied to investment management. Must have direct experience in designing and maintaining a chart of accounts for fund structures, with a clear understanding of how accounts are organized across assets, liabilities, equity, income, and expenses at the fund entity level.
Act as the system owner/sponsor for the company’s accounting and reporting system.

Prepare and perform the review of financial data and preparation of financial statements and reports for both internal and external purposes and do accounting and reporting problem resolution consistent with strategic objectives of Company and in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, applicable regulations, and company policies and procedures.
Prepare various financial reports as required from time to time.
Providing support to other departments and managers in the matters of Finance and payments.
Deal with internal and external auditors and supply relevant information.
Work closely with the members of the service provider team on Finance related matters to ensure smooth coordination in day-to-day functioning and achievement of role objectives.
Ensure high standards of confidentiality and ethics to safeguard commercially sensitive information.

Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML & CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
Maintain high professional standards to uphold clients reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
Maintaining the general ledger across proprietary funds and discretionary client mandates
Preparing period-end trial balances, income statements, and fund balance sheets
Managing expense accrual cycle including management fees, performance fees, custody, administration, and audit costs.
Deep understanding in how money moves through a fund, from investor subscriptions and redemptions through to income recognition, fee accruals, and financial statement preparation.
At least one institutional fund accounting or portfolio management platform.

Thndr Capital is Thndr’s new CMA-licensed entity in Saudi Arabia. You’ll be the person the CMA and the wider capital markets ecosystem know at Thndr, and you’ll shape how we enter and grow in the market. At Thndr, Policy is our enabler for innovation: it isn’t a back-office approval step, it works alongside Product, Tech and Operations from the start. You’ll build the regulator relationships that get our products approved at speed, spot regulatory issues before they become blockers, and push for changes that improve the market for every investor. You’ll work closely with Compliance, who protect the licence and run day-to-day controls. You’ll be part of Thndr’s Group Policy team, bringing the model already working in Egypt and the UAE to KSA.
q: We want a policy leader with regulator credibility, commercial instinct, and the judgment to open doors in a new market while setting the standard for how Thndr engages with it.
8+ years in public policy, regulatory affairs or licensing in Saudi capital markets, at the CMA or a licensed firm (regulator-side experience is a strong plus)
Deep working knowledge of the CMA framework
Established, trusted relationships at the CMA, Tadawul, Edaa and Muqassa and other governmental bodies.
A track record of taking licences or approvals from scoping to activation, and of winning regulatory change through proposals or consultation responses
Product-minded: able to sit with Product and Tech, understand how a feature works, and translate regulation into clear requirements and sequencing
Comfortable with fintech, digital onboarding and AI, with a conviction that regulation can enable innovation and a record of putting that into practice
Strong written and verbal communication, from formal regulatory letters to presenting to senior officials
Based in Riyadh or willing to relocate

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.
History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:
High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.
Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.
Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.
We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:
EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025
#1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year
40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions
Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.
Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.
At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.
r: Stakeholder relationships: Move Thndr from a transactional relationship to a proactive, ongoing dialogue with the CMA and the wider Saudi capital markets ecosystem, backed by a clear stakeholder map, engagement cadence and escalation path.
Scope and apply for the licences and approvals new products and features need in KSA, in line with the product roadmap.
Map the applicable rules and work with Legal, Compliance and Security to agree Thndr’s positioning and requirements before we engage the regulator.

Lobbying and proposals: Work with Product, Tech and Operations to find regulatory and operational bottlenecks, then lobby for the improvements and approvals that let us expand products and markets at speed.
Horizon scanning: Track CMA consultation papers and new rules, assess their impact on the business, and respond on Thndr’s behalf.
Group policy model: Bring the policy model already working in Egypt and the UAE to KSA, and shape the KSA policy roadmap.
